text: Ascaris-family roundworms follow the same basic cycle in chickens: eggs are eaten, hatch in the proventriculus, and larvae/adults develop in the small intestine, feeding on gut contents and producing large numbers of eggs shed in feces to be eaten by other birds. Treat with Piperazine, Levamisole, or Tetramizole, given for 1 day, twice within 3 weeks.
